concepts.title: 1. Витрина
concepts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished full-screen main-menu UI concept for an original fantasy collectible card game, landscape 16:9, straight-on digital screenshot, no device surround. Input image 1 is the approved COLLECTION SCREEN STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, NOT an edit target: match its deep teal weathered stone, warm bronze chamfered frames, ivory readable labels, restrained golden active highlights. Input image 2 is the approved spark-fox creature art reference; input image 3 is the approved stone-beetle creature art reference. Keep recognizable creatures in that same vibrant friendly painterly fantasy style. The game title is the working title "Карточная дуэль", not a new invented brand. Menu must be realistically implementable in Unity uGUI, coherent clean information hierarchy, generous spacing, large readable Russian labels, chunky tactile buttons and no tiny clutter. NO decorative leaves, branches, vines or floral ornaments on UI or background. The main background must be visibly illustrated or textured, never plain black. Six elemental themes are fire, water, earth, wind, light and dark; restrained elemental emblems permitted. ONLY existing functionality: play against AI, local two-player on one screen, collection/deck editor, selected-deck status, AI difficulty and fast-animations toggle. Do not add shops, campaigns, battle passes, ranked mode, currencies, player levels, daily rewards, news, accounts or online multiplayer. Exact visible labels: title "Карточная дуэль"; main primary action "Против ИИ"; secondary action "Вдвоём за одним экраном"; collection action "Коллекция"; deck status "Земля и Свет" and "9 / 9"; difficulty "Сложность ИИ: Обычная"; toggle "Быстрые анимации" with "Выкл". Render Cyrillic cleanly and exactly, avoid additional unrequested copy. Title in elegant restrained fantasy serif; controls in highly legible ivory type. These are three alternative visual concepts, so follow the specified composition distinctly. No numbered collage, no multiple screens: output a single finished menu. COMPOSITION A — ASYMMETRIC CHARACTER SHOWCASE: a compact well-spaced vertical navigation stack occupies the left 38 percent, with title above, primary bronze-edged play button, second local-play button, then collection button; selected-deck plaque below with a small fan of three creature cards and deck name/count; difficulty and fast toggle along the lower-left footer. The right 60 percent is a breathtaking large full-bodied spark fox on a worn stone plinth in a teal rocky magical landscape with distant mountain silhouettes, small warm embers contrasting cool stone. No trees or leaf decorations. The fox is a hero illustration outside a card frame, looking toward the menu; don't obscure controls. Restrained dark vignette behind left controls, colorful warm creature on the right, premium game title screen. Strong focal hierarchy primary play then character then collection.

All three creature cards fully differentiated without extra UI labels; retain dark teal plus warm copper-gold palette. Composition emphasizes currently equipped deck and immediate game setup, visually different from vertical central menu and character showcase.
